Error.description: Error response returned when the request is unsuccessful.

code.description: An error code that identifies the type of error that occurred.

details.description: Additional details that can help the caller understand or fix the issue.

message.description: A message that describes the error condition.

ErrorList.description: A list of error responses returned when a request is unsuccessful.

InventoryUpdate.description: Inventory details required to update some or all items for the requested warehouse.

isFullUpdate.description: When true, this request contains a full feed.

items.description: A list of inventory items with updated details, including quantity available.

sellingParty.description: ID of the selling party or vendor.

ItemDetails.description: Updated inventory details for an item.

availableQuantity.description: Total item quantity available in the warehouse.

buyerProductIdentifier.description: The buyer selected product identification of the item.

isObsolete.description: When true, the item is permanently unavailable.

vendorProductIdentifier.description: The vendor selected product identification of the item.

amount.description: Quantity of units available for a specific item.

unitOfMeasure.description: Unit of measure for the available quantity.

PartyIdentification.description: Name, address and tax details of a party.

SubmitInventoryUpdateRequest.description: The request body for the submitInventoryUpdate operation.

inventory.description: Inventory details required to update some or all items for the requested warehouse.

SubmitInventoryUpdateResponse.description: The response schema for the submitInventoryUpdate operation.

payload.description: The response payload for the submitInventoryUpdate operation.
